description: Turn three minutes at a council or community meeting into the version that actually moves the decision — a public comment built as ask-story-evidence-ask, timed to the real decision process, with a neighbor coalition plan and the written follow-up officials can act on. Use when someone says 'I want to speak at the council meeting', 'they're planning X on our street', 'how do I fight this decision', or 'write my public comment'.
